design.title: Do messages change contributions?
design.question: Does allowing messages change the share contributed to a common pool?
design.hypothesis: Scarcity changes the fraction of available resources contributed.

observation.rules: Each round you receive 10 credits. Privately choose a contribution from 0 to 10. All choices are sealed until everyone decides. Contributions are multiplied by 2 and shared equally. You keep unspent credits. Messages/reports become visible after settlement. A promise is your minimum contribution NEXT round; the researcher checks it. A report states your exact private signal; that signal does not change payoffs. Forecast predicts the other agents' mean contribution fraction this round. Use an empty target for public communication; otherwise use a participant key.
